Title: Azure Data Share in-place sharing for Azure Data Explorer now generally available

Body.Content:
Announcing the general availability of Azure Data Share In-place Sharing for Azure Data Explorer. This integration enables you to share big data between internal departments, with external partners, vendors, or customers for near-real-time collaboration. Customers will be able to share data in-place with Azure Data Share at no additional cost.

Read our documentation to learn more about how it works and how our customers are leveraging this capability.

Learn more
